threat_event: Technician views or copies personal photos, messages, or account data from customer devices in the company's custody
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Session recording and USB blocking missing on 48 legacy-image bench PCs at 14 stores; personal phones can be connected; the March 2026 Store 17 case
affected_asset_or_process: Customer devices in custody; SYS-07; BP-02; BP-06; BP-08
regulatory_driver: N81-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(n)); N81-R02 (Fla. Stat. 501.171(1)(a); (2)); Manufacturer A agreement (contract)
existing_controls: Customer data access standard with test checklists; confidentiality agreements; background checks; session recording and USB blocking at the Depot and 20 stores
treatment_plan: Standard bench image at the remaining 14 stores; block personal phone pairing; monthly review of bench session flags by Store Managers; refresher training on what counts as snooping
exposure_estimate_usd: $150K-$600K (notification, counsel, lost authorization, partner and customer churn)

threat_event: Legacy device passcodes and account passwords in ticket notes are exposed through a compromised SYS-01 account or a bulk export
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 11,800 legacy tickets with passcodes and 640 with account passwords in notes readable by every SYS-01 role; copies in the weekly export
existing_controls: Restricted passcode field purged at release since 2024-09; MFA on all named accounts
treatment_plan: Purge legacy notes with the vendor's bulk redaction tool; verify with a repeat search; let the export copies age out
exposure_estimate_usd: $400K-$1.5M (up to 12,400 customers notified; account takeover claims)

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts store endpoints, Depot systems, the lab storage, and cloud workloads, halting intake, repairs, mail-in, and partner claims
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat networks at 12 stores; 48 bench PCs without EDR (31 unsupported); untested restores of the lab and workloads
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04; SYS-05; SYS-06; SYS-07; SYS-09; SYS-10; BP-01 to BP-08
sp800_53_controls: CP-9; CP-4; CP-10; SC-7; SI-3; SI-4
existing_controls: EDR on office endpoints and 190 bench PCs with 24x7 MSSP; MFA; write-once backups in a separate account
treatment_plan: Standard bench image with EDR everywhere; segment the 12 older stores; quarterly restore tests; ransomware tabletop

threat_event: A skimming script injected into the mail-in checkout page overlays or captures card data entered by customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No script inventory, authorization, content security policy, or change detection on the page that embeds the gateway fields; 3 unexplained scripts found in P07
regulatory_driver: N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 6.4.3; 11.6.1; SAQ A eligibility); N81-R02 (Fla. Stat. 501.171(1)(g)1.a)
existing_controls: Payment fields hosted by the gateway; WAF; peer review of code changes
treatment_plan: Script inventory with business justification; content security policy and subresource integrity; change and tamper detection alerting to the MSSP; remove the 3 unexplained scripts
exposure_estimate_usd: $300K-$1.2M (forensic investigation, card brand assessments through the acquirer, notification of about 52,000 annual checkout customers)

threat_event: Recovered customer data kept beyond retention is stolen or exposed from the lab storage, delivery storage, or backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Lab purge job failed since 2025-11 (about 27 TB from about 2,300 cases); business account links never expire; older array shelf not encrypted
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06; SYS-04 delivery storage; backup vault; BP-08
existing_controls: Lab room badge access; lab network separated at the Depot
treatment_plan: Repair the purge job and alert on failure; purge the backlog; encrypt the older shelf; expiring links with one-time codes for business accounts
exposure_estimate_usd: $200K-$900K (highly personal data of up to 2,300 customers)

threat_event: Lab storage and its backups cannot be restored after a failure or attack, so in-progress images are lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nightly backup never fully restore-tested; some failing media can be read only once
existing_controls: Nightly backup to the write-once vault in a separate account
treatment_plan: Full restore test of a lab volume each quarter from 2026-11-16; document the lab recovery runbook

threat_event: Malware on a customer device spreads over a flat store network to bench, counter, and office devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12 older stores have one flat network; 48 bench PCs lack EDR
existing_controls: Site firewalls; EDR on office endpoints
treatment_plan: Bench and customer-device VLAN at the 12 older stores, starting with the 4 busiest

threat_event: Data is recovered from a recycling drop-off device that was not properly sanitized
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12 stores wipe with no certificate; no validation step; recycler certificates by lot; procedure still on SP 800-88 Rev. 1
existing_controls: Depot certificates per device; locked bins; certified recycler
treatment_plan: Move all store drop-offs to the Depot sanitization line; adopt SP 800-88 Rev. 2 with verification and validation; serial-level recycler certificates

threat_event: A PIN pad is tampered with or swapped for a skimming device at a store
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inspection logs missing or incomplete at 9 stores; terminal list differs from the processor list by 6 devices
existing_controls: P2PE encryption; terminals in view of staff; tamper-evident seals
treatment_plan: Reconcile the terminal list; weekly inspection logs in SYS-01 checklists with Regional Manager review; tamper training
exposure_estimate_usd: $50K-$250K (card brand case through the acquirer; replacement; notification if data taken)

threat_event: SYS-01 vendor outage exceeds the store MTD of 8 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor stated RTO 8 hours versus BIA RTO 4 hours; single SaaS dependency for intake and release
existing_controls: Paper intake and release kits; standalone P2PE; weekly SYS-01 export
treatment_plan: Store downtime kits and drill; recovery terms at the 2027 renewal; read-only export for release lookups

threat_event: Partner integration API is down or faulty for more than a business day, missing partner acknowledgement times
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No tested recovery for the API; single region; no daily outcome reconciliation
existing_controls: Partners replay claims for 72 hours; infrastructure code; container images in the registry
treatment_plan: Recovery test in an isolated account; daily outcome reconciliation; partner outage notice template

threat_event: A vulnerability in the partner API or mail-in portal exposes claim or order data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No static, dependency, or secret scanning; secrets in pipeline variables; 2026-05 test found an authorization flaw (fixed)
existing_controls: Annual penetration test; WAF; mutual TLS for partners; peer review
treatment_plan: Security scanning gates in the pipeline; secrets to the secrets service; threat modeling for new endpoints

threat_event: Leaked pipeline secrets let an attacker deploy code or read workload data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Long-lived deployment credentials in pipeline variables
existing_controls: Pipeline access limited to 6 developers with MFA
treatment_plan: Short-lived workload identity for deployments; rotate all pipeline secrets; secret scanning

threat_event: A former employee signs in to a manufacturer portal or the contact center platform after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Local accounts outside the identity provider; removed by email; 9 of 25 sampled leavers still active in a manufacturer portal (P07)
existing_controls: Identity provider disabled automatically at termination
treatment_plan: Termination checklist ticket covering local accounts; monthly reconciliation of manufacturer and contact center accounts against HR; federation where the vendor supports it

threat_event: Manufacturer A finds program breaches at its 2026-10 audit (local account gaps, no 24-hour notice procedure) and restricts authorized status
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Leaver accounts active in its portal; notice clock missing from the 2024 plan; the Store 17 case
existing_controls: Background checks; confidentiality agreements; customer data access standard
treatment_plan: Remove leaver accounts before the audit; 24-hour notice procedure in P08; evidence pack for the auditor
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$5M (loss of about $17M a year of warranty reimbursements if authorization were restricted)

threat_event: Partner P1 does not receive a SOC 2 Type 2 report by 2027-12-31 and moves claims to another network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Controls defined but not yet operating consistently; no service auditor engaged
existing_controls: Readiness assessment (P09); POA&M
treatment_plan: Remediate Not ready criteria by 2027-03-31; 6-month observation period from 2027-04-01; engage an independent CPA firm
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$8M (loss of about $8M to $16M a year of partner revenue)

threat_event: Notice deadlines are missed after an incident (acquirer and Manufacturer A 24 hours, partners 48 hours, Florida 30 days, other states)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2024 plan covers ransomware only; contract clocks not listed; last tabletop March 2025
regulatory_driver: N81-R02 (Fla. Stat. 501.171(3); (4); (6)); N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 12.10.1); Manufacturer A agreement (contract); Partner agreements (contract)
existing_controls: MSSP escalation; insurer panel counsel
treatment_plan: P08 runbooks and notification matrix; tabletop exercises 2026-11-18 and 2027-02-17
exposure_estimate_usd: $50K-$500K (Florida civil penalties up to $500,000 per breach under 501.171(9); contract remedies)

threat_event: A workforce member or attacker exports or browses large numbers of customer records without detection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-01 export and bulk-view events not reviewed or sent to the SIEM; no alerting
existing_controls: Role-based access; MFA
treatment_plan: Forward SYS-01 audit events to the SIEM; alerts on bulk exports and unusual views; monthly review by Store Managers of their staff's activity

threat_event: An unsupported bench operating system is exploited and used to reach other systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31 bench PCs on an unsupported OS for legacy diagnostic tools; no EDR
existing_controls: Store firewalls
treatment_plan: Move the 31 PCs to an isolated offline bench segment now; replace the tools or PCs by 2027-06-30

threat_event: Business email compromise changes partner, vendor, or business account bank details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Call-back rule exists for vendors but not for business account refunds; finance targeted by phishing in 2026
existing_controls: MFA on email; vendor bank change call-back
treatment_plan: Extend call-back verification to all bank detail changes and refunds over $1,000; targeted finance training

threat_event: A phished Store Manager or administrator account is used to issue fraudulent refunds or change SYS-01 settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA only; 4 Depot supervisors use everyday accounts for SYS-01 administration
existing_controls: MFA with number matching; refunds above $250 need a Store Manager
treatment_plan: Separate administrator accounts; phishing-resistant keys for administrators by 2027-06-30; refund anomaly report

threat_event: Store staff issue fraudulent refunds or discounts through the POS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Refund report reviewed monthly, not weekly
existing_controls: Manager approval above $250; monthly refund report
treatment_plan: Weekly refund exception report reviewed by Regional Managers

threat_event: Customer records kept since 2016 are exposed in a breach, multiplying notice costs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1.9 million records; policy of 3 years after last service never enforced
existing_controls: Encryption by the vendor
treatment_plan: Purge records older than 3 years after last service (about 1.1 million) with the vendor; automate yearly
exposure_estimate_usd: Notification costs scale from about $0.5M to $3M with record count

threat_event: A recovered-data link for a business account is forwarded or guessed and the data is accessed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Business account links never expire and need no code
existing_controls: Long random link identifiers; consumer links expire after 14 days
treatment_plan: 14-day expiry and one-time code for all links

threat_event: Chatbot vendor retains transcripts containing passcodes and personal data or uses them to train models
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No data-use terms; customers type passcodes into chats
existing_controls: Vendor privacy policy (not negotiated)
treatment_plan: Contract terms (no training, 30-day retention, breach notice); input masking; warning banner

threat_event: The unsubstantiated "97% accurate" AI diagnosis claim draws FTC or state attorney general action or customer complaints
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No accuracy measurement behind the claim
existing_controls: Technicians confirm faults before quoting
treatment_plan: Remove the claim now; publish only measured, dated statements (P10)

threat_event: AI-assisted diagnostics suggest wrong or costlier repairs, worse for some device groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No accuracy or segment testing; suggestions shown on the quote screen
existing_controls: Technician confirms the fault
treatment_plan: Technician diagnosis required before quoting; monthly accuracy and segment testing (P10)

threat_event: Calls are recorded and summarized by AI without the consent of every party, including outbound callbacks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inbound greeting announces recording for quality but not AI processing; outbound callbacks have no announcement
existing_controls: Inbound recording announcement
treatment_plan: Updated inbound announcement including AI summaries; outbound script and recording off until consent; vendor data-use terms

threat_event: The AI applicant ranking feature screens out protected groups at a higher rate (adverse impact)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature turned on by recruiting in 2026-02 without review; no adverse impact monitoring; low-ranked applicants rarely reviewed
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Pause auto-ranking; human review of all applicants meeting minimum qualifications; quarterly selection-rate analysis using the four-fifths rule of thumb (P10)

threat_event: Parts demand forecasts are wrong and stores run out of common parts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: New forecasting module in the ERP since 2026-04
existing_controls: Buyer approval of every purchase order
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Supply Chain Director: buyers approve every order; residual risk Low

threat_event: Staff paste customer data, device photos, or passcodes into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public tools reachable from office endpoints; enterprise assistant not yet available
existing_controls: POL-05 prohibits it
treatment_plan: Block public AI tools on company endpoints; provide an approved enterprise assistant with data-use terms; training

threat_event: A courier loses a mail-in parcel containing a customer device with data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Courier contract has no loss-handling or data terms
existing_controls: Tracked shipping with signature; parcel insurance
treatment_plan: Courier terms at renewal; mail-in instructions to back up and remove accounts where the repair allows

threat_event: The recycler mishandles devices or cannot prove what happened to a specific device
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Certificates by lot; recycler never assessed
existing_controls: Certified recycler; Depot certificates
treatment_plan: Serial-level certificates; annual site audit of the recycler

threat_event: A hurricane closes stores or the Depot for several days while customer devices are in custody
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contingency plan; no Depot alternate site; devices on shelves at some stores
existing_controls: SaaS reachable from anywhere; storm prep checklist at stores
treatment_plan: Contingency plan with storm procedures: secure devices, notify customers, move intake to open stores, partner notice

threat_event: Fire, flood, or power loss closes the Depot
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single Depot site for mail-in, Depot repair, partner repairs, data recovery, and recycling
existing_controls: Generator for the lab and server room; fire suppression
treatment_plan: Alternate receiving at two large stores; partner repair overflow agreement with Manufacturer B's other depots (to negotiate)
exposure_estimate_usd: About $80,000 a day of revenue at risk

threat_event: A repaired device is released to the wrong person, exposing the owner's data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Release checklist followed at most stores; 2 misreleases in 2026
existing_controls: Photo ID or one-time code at release
treatment_plan: Scan the claim code at release so the ticket must match; quarterly release audits

threat_event: Customer devices are stolen from a store back room after hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Locked cabinets at most stores; alarm and CCTV
existing_controls: Alarm; CCTV; locked cabinets
treatment_plan: Cabinets at the 3 stores still using shelves

threat_event: The company performs data recovery for a HIPAA covered entity and becomes a business associate without a business associate agreement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Decline policy relies on staff recognizing medical and dental clients; 2 cases accepted at a store in 2026
regulatory_driver: N81-R06 (45 CFR 160.103 definition of business associate)
existing_controls: Policy declining PHI work since 2025
treatment_plan: Intake question and business account flag for health care clients; counsel review of the 2 cases; training for the lab and stores

threat_event: Background check reports are disposed of improperly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some printed reports kept at stores during hiring
existing_controls: Reports kept in the HR SaaS; shredding bins
treatment_plan: No printing of reports; quarterly check by HR

threat_event: Configuration drift on bench images, container hosts, and network devices opens exploitable weaknesses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No benchmark-based baselines for bench images or containers; changes to network devices by email
existing_controls: Cloud guardrails; office endpoint baselines
treatment_plan: Issue STD-01 with benchmark baselines and a monthly drift report; change records for network changes

threat_event: Internet-facing vulnerabilities stay open past their remediation targets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7 of 40 sampled Critical findings were late
existing_controls: Monthly scans of internet-facing systems since 2026-06
treatment_plan: Weekly known-exploited vulnerability review; remediation SLA tracking reported to the COO

threat_event: A cloud administrator account is taken over through credential theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 11 privileged users with just-in-time elevation and MFA
existing_controls: MFA with number matching; just-in-time elevation; sign-in alerts
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low; phishing-resistant keys planned under R-021

threat_event: A denial-of-service attack takes the mail-in portal offline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Managed gateway and WAF with rate limiting
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection; rate limits; phone bookings as fallback
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low

threat_event: Card numbers are written down or repeated during contact center or overflow service phone payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Overflow answering service has no card data terms; 5 contact center tickets with full card numbers found in P03
regulatory_driver: N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 3.2.1; 3.3.1.2; SAQ P2PE eligibility)
existing_controls: P2PE terminals in the contact center; recordings paused manually during payments
treatment_plan: Overflow service may not take payments; automatic recording pause; card-number pattern blocking in SYS-01 notes; purge the 5 tickets

threat_event: An SD-WAN or carrier outage stops intake and release at a store
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cellular failover at every store
existing_controls: Cellular failover; standalone P2PE; paper kits
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Director of Retail Operations: residual risk Low

threat_event: The SYS-01 vendor suffers a breach that exposes company customer records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Concentration of 1.9 million records at one SaaS vendor
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Confidentiality); vendor notice within 72 hours
treatment_plan: Reduce what is kept (R-002, R-023); 24-hour notice term at renewal; annual SOC 2 and CUEC review

threat_event: Repair outcomes sent to partners are missing, duplicated, or wrong, causing billing disputes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No daily reconciliation between SYS-01 tickets and outcomes posted to partners
existing_controls: Schema validation; weekly invoice reconciliation
treatment_plan: Daily automated reconciliation with exception queue; processing integrity controls for SOC 2 (P09)

threat_event: Attacker or insider uses vendor default passwords on store CCTV recorders to view or delete footage (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default administrator passwords on recorders at 5 of 8 visited stores, reachable from the store network
existing_controls: Recorders behind the store firewall
treatment_plan: Change passwords at all 34 stores; move recorders to the management VLAN; add to the configuration baseline

threat_event: Parts or customer devices are diverted by staff at the Depot
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Serial traceability for Manufacturer A parts; cycle counts monthly
existing_controls: Serial tracking; CCTV; badge access
treatment_plan: Weekly variance report on high-value parts

threat_event: Partner claim data is used for the company's own marketing, breaching the partner agreements
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Marketing list built from SYS-01 includes partner claimants
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Exclude partner claimants from marketing lists by a SYS-01 flag; train marketing
